summary_en: Porters Corporation will acquire an additional 21,000 shares of KIKAN flex, a consolidated subsidiary, to achieve 100% ownership. The acquisition price is undisclosed. The company determined that operating KIKAN flex as a wholly owned subsidiary would better advance group value creation for its core business system serving the staffing industry.
title_en: Notice Regarding Full Ownership of Consolidated Subsidiary Through Additional Share Acquisition
translation_en_brief:
On September 30, 2026, Porters Corporation's board of directors resolved to acquire an additional 21,000 shares of KIKAN flex Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, for full ownership. The company currently holds 65.0% (39,000 shares) of KIKAN flex and will increase its stake to 100% (60,000 shares total). The acquisition price is undisclosed, having been determined through mutual negotiation between the parties based on the company's evaluation using fair value net asset method and similar approaches.

KIKAN flex develops and sells a core system platform for staffing companies, aimed at establishing a positive foundation for temporary staffing work. The subsidiary conducted a third-party allotment increase in October 2025 with Persol Tempstaff Co., Ltd. as the recipient. The company determined that operating KIKAN flex as a wholly owned subsidiary, rather than jointly with Persol Tempstaff, would enable more agile business promotion and create greater value for the Porters group as a whole.
